definition: Any extension from a neuron's cell body: an axon or a dendrite.
A Blue Brain morphological type, mostly in layer 6: a pyramidal cell whose main dendrite points down toward the white matter instead of up.
A cortical interneuron with two main dendrites, one up and one down; most are VIP-positive.
The main output neuron of the olfactory bulb, receiving input from one glomerulus.
A neuron in entorhinal cortex that fires when the animal is near a wall or edge of its environment.
A small molecule inside a cell, such as calcium, cAMP or IP3, that carries a signal from a receptor to targets inside the cell.
The straight-line distance between two points.
Red, green and blue, the three colour channels a display mixes to make every colour. VGA carries each as a separate analog signal.
A plain-text format for structured data; this library stores its pages and terms in JSON files.
